C275.story: A British five pence dated 1992, struck in cupronickel for everyday circulation. The obverse shows Raphael Maklouf's crowned portrait of Elizabeth II with the date in the legend. The reverse carries the crowned thistle design marked FIVE PENCE. The Royal Mint at Llantrisant struck about 453 million five pence coins in 1992.
